title: Zero-error randomized decision tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an alphabet, let $\alpha$ be an output type, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f : \Omega^n \to \alpha$. A zero-error randomized decision tree for $f$ consists of a finite nonempty seed space with a probability distribution, together with a finite decision tree on $\Omega^n$ for each seed, such that every tree computes $f$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution is specified on the seed space
Each seed selects a finite decision tree
